item_verdicts.diff: read all four commits; the repair moves the 23 ids onto shipped behaviour, and commit 000c7881 pins the two repairs that had been measuring the runner rather than the contract -- the landing-grant assertion is parameterized over _can_write_worktree with both branches asserted, and the redispatch ordering assertion back-dates each delivery to the attempt that wrote it.

item_verdicts.manifest: the reviewed manifest passes the write-time audit (reckon crew check-manifest returns ok true with no findings) and carries commits, changed paths, gate logs, the negative control, baseline and after suites, and follow_ons naming the product defect, the environment-sensitive ledger id and the freshness-boundary fragility; status complete.
item_verdicts.write_paths: five changed paths, all inside the declared fence -- tests/test_crew.py, tests/test_ledger.py, docs/plans/the-suite-is-green-at-head.html (landing note only), a new evidence anchor docs/evidence/archive/the-suite-is-green-at-head-landed.html, and docs/figures/the-suite-is-green-at-head/repair_delta.png; the evidence anchor is a new file so no cumulative record was overwritten, and the plan meta at head still reads plan-*, untouched by the worker.

justifications.fit: commits carry conventional subjects with bodies and no attribution, added names describe mechanism (_predate_delivery, the parametrized ids), and no plan, sprint or ticket identifier appears in a symbol, filename or comment in the diff.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the base failure set equals the research's declared node set in both directions (17 crew plus 6 ledger, both logs read at 77c20349), and the single head failure is the product defect the manifest names, with the run-time refusal at tests/test_crew.py:3295 and the product lines it cites (reckon/crew/ticker.py:172, reckon/crew/recovery.py:3627, reckon/crew/runs.py:2420) verified present at the reviewed head.
